2607.17674.title: Uncovering Latent Reasoning Strategies in Language Models
2607.17674.paper_summary: A language model $p_θ(y \mid x)$ trained on reasoning tasks learns to solve problems via multiple distinct strategies, yet these strategies are implicit and entangled within the model's response distribution. We study the problem of decomposing the response distribution of a given pretrained language model into a structured, strategy-conditioned representation. Specifically, we learn a latent-variable factorization $p_θ(y \mid x) \leadsto (r_φ(z \mid x), g_φ(y \mid x,z))$, where a router $r$ maps each input to a distribution over latent strategies $z$ and a generator $g$ produces the response conditioned on that strategy. A key challenge is that the generator, initialized from the base model, already represents $p_θ(y \mid x)$ without using $z$. Standard variational inference therefore gives the model no incentive to route information through $z$ and can yield a severe form of posterior collapse. To address this, we propose a variational objective that measures fractional information gain relative to the base model's response loss and concentrates reconstruction pressure on tokens with high base model surprisal, encouraging $z$ to encode strategy-relevant response variation. We introduce a benchmark of multi-strategy algorithmic tasks and show that this objective recovers latent codes aligned with distinct reference strategies while preserving the base model's response distribution.
2607.17674.paper_summary_zh: 一個訓練於推理任務的語言模型 $p_θ(y \mid x)$ 學會通過多種不同的策略來解決問題，但這些策略在模型的回應分佈中是隱含且交織在一起的。我們研究將給定的預訓練語言模型的回應分佈分解成結構化、策略條件表示的問題。具體而言，我們學習一個潛在變量分解 $p_θ(y \mid x) \leadsto (r_φ(z \mid x), g_φ(y \mid x,z))$，其中路由器 $r$ 將每個輸入映射到潛在策略 $z$ 的分佈，而生成器 $g$ 則根據該策略生成回應。一個主要挑戰是，從基礎模型初始化的生成器，已經在不使用 $z$ 的情況下表示 $p_θ(y \mid x)$。因此，標準變分推斷並未給模型提供通過 $z$ 路由信息的動機，並可能導致嚴重的後驗崩潰。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一個變分目標，該目標測量相對於基礎模型回應損失的分數信息增益，並將重建壓力集中在具有高基礎模型驚訝度的標記上，鼓勵 $z$ 編碼與策略相關的回應變化。我們引入了一個多策略算法任務的基準，並展示這個目標能夠恢復與不同參考策略對齊的潛在代碼，同時保留基礎模型的回應分佈。
